actionable_exact_outcome.definition: The named outcome occurred within 180 minutes of the model ETA
actionable_exact_outcome.denominator: Every scoreable bet; false alarms, wrong outcomes, and badly timed outcomes are misses

base_selection.base_pick_lift: Model capture rate divided by its scouted-region baseline
base_selection.capture: Selected base reached faction ownership by its scoring deadline
base_selection.exact_outcome: Observed outcome exactly matched the model's named outcome
base_selection.map_baseline: Share of all strategic bases at the round cutoff captured during the same bet window
base_selection.pipeline_lift: Model capture rate divided by the whole-map baseline
base_selection.scout_lift: Scouted-region baseline divided by the whole-map baseline
base_selection.scouted_baseline: Share of strategic bases in that model's six selected regions captured during the same bet window
base_selection.transition: Selected base had any physical ownership transition by its scoring deadline

Weathered Expanse likewise shows no new flips, yet its daily casualties remain immense, exceeding twenty-two thousand Warden and nineteen thousand Colonial losses. Farranac Coast has quieted, and DeadLands has not added to its Salt March flurry since earlier. The war, now in its 125th day, still runs without a declared victor.

history.headline: Fishermans Row and Lykos Isle Trade Strongholds Again
history.war_summary: Since the last edition, Fishermans Row has not gone quiet: ten strategic-base events in the past two hours, thirty-eight on the day, with Fort Ember, Arcadia, and Peripti Landing among the most frequently touched positions. Lykos Isle is likewise still in motion, with five events in two hours and fourteen on the day, led by Mārudia, Fort Guile, and Cyrus. Weathered Expanse remains active as well—two events in the latest two-hour window, nine on the day, most often at Spirit Watch and Foxcatcher—and its 24-hour losses are enormous: more than twenty thousand Colonial and twenty-three thousand Warden casualties. Stlican Shelf has re-emerged as a contested sector, registering one flip in the past two hours and eight on the day at Fort Hoarfrost and The Old Mourn. DeadLands, quiet in the previous edition's recent windows, now shows two fresh events at The Salt March and Callahan's Boot. Farranac Coast has produced no flips in the past two hours but retains eleven on the day, concentrated around Mara and Terra.

history.headline: Fishermans Row, Lykos Isle Keep Strongholds in Flux
history.war_summary: Since the last edition, Fishermans Row remains the busiest front, with seven strategic-base changes in the past two hours and thirty on the day; Fort Ember has traded hands repeatedly, while Peripti Landing and Hangman's Court stay in the mix. Lykos Isle has stirred again, recording three flips in the last two hours, with Mārudia and Cyrus prominent. Weathered Expanse, previously a casualty sink without recorded flips, now shows four ownership events in the past day, all within the latest two-hour window at Foxcatcher and Necropolis. Tempest Island, Godcrofts, Farranac Coast, and DeadLands have quieted in the most recent windows, although their twenty-four-hour totals remain meaningful. Casualty totals continue to climb across the map; Weathered Expanse alone reports more than twenty-two thousand Colonial and twenty-four thousand Warden losses in a day, with Fishermans Row, Lykos Isle, Stlican Shelf, and Farranac Coast also heavy. On war day 119, no side has yet reached the thirty-four victory towns required for conquest.

history.headline: Fishermans Row, Lykos Isle Trade Strongholds as War Grinds On
history.war_summary: Since the last edition, the wires have remained hot. Fishermans Row leads the front with four stronghold changes in the last two hours and nineteen in the past day; Hangman's Court and Fort Ember have seen the heaviest traffic. Lykos Isle, quiet earlier, has stirred again with two flips in the last two hours and twenty in the past day, centered on Fort Guile and The Squall. Tempest Island has slowed to no changes in the last two hours but still shows fourteen on the day, with Isle of Psyche and Blackwatch active. Farranac Coast, Godcrofts, and DeadLands have gone quiet on the latest event sheet, though their twenty-four-hour totals remain significant. Weathered Expanse continues to consume casualties on a prodigious scale—tens of thousands in a day—without a recorded change of ownership. On war day 116, no side has reached the thirty-four victory towns required for conquest; the front remains undecided.

history.headline: Lull Broken as Fishermans Row, Tempest Island Trade Strongholds
history.war_summary: Since the previous edition the wires have come alive again. Fishermans Row and Tempest Island both logged a fresh round of stronghold transfers inside the past two hours, while Godcrofts stirred once more at Lipsia. Farranac Coast and Lykos Isle have gone quiet on the latest event sheet, but Lykos carries the day's heaviest count at twenty-four flips, and Farranac remains among the leaders at fifteen. Weathered Expanse, DeadLands, and Stlican Shelf remain stubborn killing grounds; Weathered Expanse has burned through tens of thousands of casualties without a single recorded change of ownership in the past day. On war day 113, with no side yet at the thirty-four victory towns required for conquest, the front is still undecided.

history.headline: Farranac and Lykos Flare as Night Action Shifts
history.war_summary: Since the previous edition, the map has gone quiet at the latest hour, with no strategic-base events logged anywhere in the past two hours. The most recent reports are Farranac Coast at 04:10 and Lykos Isle at 03:38, while Oarbreaker and Stlican Shelf—active earlier in the night—have not stirred since 02:25 and 01:25. Farranac Coast remains the liveliest contested front on the 24-hour board with fifteen ownership events and a mixed base split; Lykos Isle leads the day’s count with twenty-four. Heavier casualty fronts such as Weathered Expanse, DeadLands, Marban Hollow, and Stlican Shelf continue to drain men without fresh flips. Godcrofts, Fishermans Row, and Tempest Island still show late action on the day’s ledger but have gone quiet in recent hours. On war day 110, neither side has reached the thirty-four victory towns required for conquest.

history.headline: Oarbreaker and Stlican Shelf Flare as Night Action Shifts
history.war_summary: Since the last edition, the night's action has shifted to two quieter fronts. Oarbreaker and Stlican Shelf were the only regions to record strategic-base events in the final two hours, each logging two—Oarbreaker at 02:25 and Stlican Shelf at 01:25. The fronts that dominated the previous report have since gone quiet: Godcrofts and Farranac Coast last recorded events at 23:43, DeadLands at 23:25, and Fishermans Row at 22:10. Lykos Isle, the day's busiest region with twenty-two events, has been still since 16:10. Clahstra saw the sharpest recent casualty spike—898 Colonials and 1,321 Wardens in two hours—yet no strategic base changed hands there. Weathered Expanse and Marban Hollow continue to grind with heavy losses but no fresh flips. The war, on its 107th day, still lacks a victor, with neither side holding the thirty-four towns required for conquest.

history.headline: Late-Night Flurry in Godcrofts and Farranac Coast
history.war_summary: Since the last edition, Godcrofts has flared anew, recording five strategic-base events in the final two hours, with Lipsia the busiest point at twelve daily events. Farranac Coast remains hot, adding three more events in the last two hours; Mara, Scythe, and Terra are each at five for the day. DeadLands has stirred from its earlier lull, The Salt March showing seven daily events and three in the closing two hours. Fishermans Row, so active at the prior cutoff, has been quiet since 22:10 though its daily count still stands at eleven. Tempest Island has not logged a strategic-base event since 18:36, and Lykos Isle, once the day's busiest front with twenty-two events, has been silent for hours. Stlican Shelf latest came at 18:52. Weathered Expanse and Marban Hollow remain heavy casualty fronts without fresh flips. The one hundred fourth day ends with neither side holding the thirty-four victory towns required for conquest.

history.headline: Evening Action Focuses on Farranac Coast and Fishermans Row
history.war_summary: Since the last edition, strategic-base events have narrowed to two fronts: Farranac Coast and Fishermans Row each logged events in the final two hours, three and four respectively. Scythe and Terra lead Farranac's daily list with five events apiece, while Fort Ember and Hangman's Court are the busiest points in Fishermans Row. Tempest Island, active through the afternoon, has been quiet for two hours but still shows fifteen daily events, with Blackwatch foremost. Stlican Shelf recorded its latest strategic-base event at 18:52, and Godcrofts has not logged one since 17:27 despite Lipsia's eight daily events. Lykos Isle, with twenty-five daily events, has cooled to three in the last six hours. DeadLands has stood still since 13:25. Weathered Expanse and Marban Hollow remain heavy casualty fronts without strategic-base flips in the latest window. The 101st day of the war finds no side holding thirty-four victory towns.

history.headline: Farranac, Fishermans and Tempest See Renewed Strongpoint Fighting
history.war_summary: Since the afternoon edition, the fight has surged on Farranac Coast, where four strategic-base changes were logged in the past two hours, with Scythe and Mara prominent in the day's exchanges. Fishermans Row has also stirred, recording four recent events around Arcadia, Peripti Landing, and other strongpoints. Tempest Island remains hot: Blackwatch, Isle of Psyche, and Surge Gate have all changed hands again, the latest at 17:53. Godcrofts, quiet at midday, is back on the board, with Lipsia and Argosa trading owners. Lykos Isle, scene of the morning's heaviest fighting, has cooled to a single event in the past two hours after twenty-five changes in the day. DeadLands, which produced fresh flips about 13:25, has gone still since then, though its daily total stands at seven. The great casualty mills—Weathered Expanse, Stlican Shelf, and Marban Hollow—continue to bleed without a strategic base changing hands. No side has yet secured the thirty-four victory towns required to end the war.

history.headline: Lykos, Tempest and DeadLands See Fresh Strongpoint Changes
history.war_summary: Since the noon dispatch, fighting has centred on Lykos Isle, where strongpoints Fort Guile and The Squall have changed hands repeatedly; seven ownership events were logged in the last two hours and twenty-two in the last day. Tempest Island has also rekindled, with Blackwatch and Surge Gate entering the log again, while the DeadLands, quiet at the last edition, has returned to the board with two fresh ownership events about 13:25. Godcrofts and The Fingers, lively earlier, have grown quiet; no event has been recorded there since mid-morning. Farranac Coast and Fishermans Row likewise remain still in strongpoint ownership, though Farranac continues to burn with heavy casualties. The great casualty mills of Weathered Expanse, Stlican Shelf, and Marban Hollow still grind on without a single strategic base changing hands. As the war enters day ninety-five, no side has yet reached the thirty-four required victory towns.

history.headline: Fresh Strongpoint Flips at Godcrofts, Lykos and Fingers
history.war_summary: Since the last edition the morning wire has grown busier. Godcrofts continues to exchange strongpoints at Argosa and Lipsia, with a fresh change logged at 10:25; Lykos Isle has followed suit around Fort Guile and The Squall, its latest flare at 10:10. Newest of all is The Fingers, where Headsman's Villa has seen three ownership events in the past two hours. Tempest Island has also stirred, with Blackwatch and Surge Gate entering the morning log. The DeadLands and Farranac Coast, lately so active, have gone quiet, as has Fishermans Row, which has not moved since late yesterday despite its big twenty-four-hour count. Casualty totals continue to climb at Weathered Expanse, Stlican Shelf, Clahstra and Marban Hollow without any strategic base changing hands. The war enters its ninety-second day, and neither side has yet reached the required thirty-four victory towns.

history.headline: Morning Wire Crackles at Lykos Isle, Godcrofts
history.war_summary: Since the last edition the morning wire has opened at Lykos Isle, where a fresh change was logged at 9:10 and two bases—Fort Guile and The Squall—have been active overnight. Godcroft's Argosa and Lipsia also figure in another round of flips, the latest at 7:25. The DeadLands and Farranac Coast, so busy earlier, have fallen quiet; DeadLands still leads the day's count with fourteen recorded shifts, and Fishermans Row's fourteen-strong list remains the largest single-region total, though that front has not moved since 10:25 p.m. Stema Landing and Tempest Island each show older events on the day's log. Elsewhere the heavy casualty totals at Weathered Expanse, Clahstra, Marban Hollow, Linn Mercy, Loch Mor, Kings Cage and Stlican Shelf continue to mount without strategic bases changing hands. The war is now in its eighty-ninth day; neither side has reached the required thirty-four victory towns.

history.headline: Farranac Coast Roars as DeadLands Exchanges Continue
history.war_summary: Since the last edition the night wire has crackled again in the DeadLands, where fresh ownership events were logged by 4:10 a.m., and Farranac Coast has burst back onto the board with three events in the early hours, the latest at 5:42 a.m. DeadLands still leads the day's tally with sixteen recorded shifts—The Salt March figuring prominently—while Fishermans Row's twenty-one changes remain the largest single-region count, though that front has been quiet since 10:25 p.m. Tempest Island saw another strategic-base change at 1:27 a.m. Stema Landing, Godcrofts and Lykos Isle each recorded night-time events, but none of those has stirred in the last two hours. Elsewhere the big casualty lists are still being written at Weathered Expanse, Clahstra and Stlican Shelf without strategic bases changing hands. The war is now in its eighty-sixth day; neither side has reached the required thirty-four victory towns.

history.headline: Tempest Island Flares; Fishermans Row Still in Heavy Fight
history.war_summary: Since the last edition, Tempest Island has flared into action, a strategic base changing hands shortly after 1 a.m. Stema Landing likewise remains unsettled, its latest move logged at 11:52 p.m. Fishermans Row still dominates the base board with twenty-three recorded changes over the past day, though the last two hours have been quiet there. DeadLands, carrying fourteen daily changes, has gone still since 7 p.m. Godcrofts broke its calm with a fresh event at 11:25 p.m., while Lykos Isle has seen five shifts, the latest near 10 p.m. Farranac Coast has not stirred since 5:50 p.m., and Linn Mercy remains dormant. Clahstra and Weathered Expanse continue to pile up casualties without any strategic bases changing hands. The war enters its eighty-third day with the ledger still split and neither side at the required victory total.

history.headline: Stema Landing Erupts as Fishermans Row Battles On
history.war_summary: Since the last edition, Stema Landing has exploded onto the base board with four actions in the past two hours, the latest at 23:52, making it the hottest point on the map. Fishermans Row remains locked in its grinding fight, tallying three fresh moves in the latest two-hour window and twenty-three over the past day, with Peripti Landing and Dankana Post still drawing the heaviest traffic. Godcrofts, after a lull, has renewed itself with a fresh event at 23:25. Lykos Isle, quiet earlier, has come back to life with three actions in the six-hour column, though its two-hour count is empty. DeadLands, despite a robust twenty-four-hour ledger of sixteen changes, has produced nothing since 19:02, and Farranac Coast holds still at 17:50, while Linn Mercy has not stirred since early morning. Tempest Island shows a lone neutralization at 21:23. Away from the base board, Clahstra and Weathered Expanse continue to run staggering casualty totals without any strategic bases changing hands. The war is now in its eightieth day.

history.headline: Fishermans Row Renews Fighting; DeadLands Churns On
history.war_summary: Since the last edition, the line has shifted again. Fishermans Row, silent through the afternoon watch, has returned to the ledger with five recorded actions in the past two hours, Peripti Landing and Dankana Post drawing the heaviest traffic; the latest blow fell at 20:35. DeadLands, which had gone quiet, stirred once more toward evening, its six-hour tally rising to five with The Salt March and Callahan's Boot prominent, though the newest two-hour window shows no further moves. Godcrofts remains busy, eight actions on the day and its most recent at 19:50, but its two-hour count has cooled to one. Farranac Coast, the previous edition's flashpoint, has fallen still since 17:50; Linn Mercy and Lykos Isle show no fresh base business since the early morning. Away from the base board, Clahstra and Weathered Expanse still run a fearsome butcher's bill, with casualty rates accelerating, yet no strategic bases have changed hands there. The war stands on its seventy-seventh day.

history.headline: Farranac Coast, Godcrofts Flash; Fishermans Row Falls Silent
history.war_summary: Since the last edition, Farranac Coast has flared into the base ledger with three actions in the past two hours, all centered on Mara, while Godcrofts has quickened from two actions to five in the same interval, Argosa and Lipsia sharing the day's honors. Fishermans Row, the previous focus, has gone silent in the latest two-hour window; its six-hour count still stands at six, with Peripti Landing and Dankana Post the busiest points. DeadLands, briefly restless at 15:36, has also lapsed into quiet, The Salt March carrying the day with eleven recorded actions. Lykos Isle has not stirred since 11:15, Linn Mercy since the early morning, and Stlican Shelf's two actions date from the previous evening. Away from the base board, Clahstra and Weathered Expanse continue to exact a heavy butcher's bill without changing hands, their casualty rates still running high. The war is in its seventy-fourth day, and the latest dispatches point to Farranac Coast and Godcrofts as the fronts to watch.

history.headline: Fishermans Row Erupts Again; DeadLands Falls Quiet
history.war_summary: Since the midday edition, the fighting has shifted back to Fishermans Row, where six strategic-base actions were logged in the last two hours—carrying a 24-hour total of thirty-four and leaving Dunkana Post and Peripti Landing the busiest positions. DeadLands, the morning's other hot front, has fallen quiet since 12:55, though its six-hour ledger still shows seven flips and heavy losses on both sides. Lykos Isle likewise has produced no new flag changes since 11:15 after an eight-action day. Linn Mercy has not stirred since an early-morning exchange; Stlican Shelf's six actions date from the previous evening. New agitation marks Godcrofts, which logged two actions in the last two hours, with Lipsia the busiest base over the day. Away from the base ledger, Weathered Expanse and Clahstra continue to exact a severe casualty toll without changing hands, and Fishermans Row's own casualty rates remain high. The war is in its seventy-first day, and the latest action has shifted decisively to Fishermans Row.

history.headline: DeadLands and Lykos Isle Roil; Fishermans Row Quiet
history.war_summary: Fresh dispatches from the midday line show DeadLands and Lykos Isle seizing the battle's tempo. DeadLands has logged three strategic-base actions in the past two hours and seven in six, bringing its daily tally to eleven, with The Salt March and Callahan's Boot changing hands repeatedly. Lykos Isle, once quiet, has posted two actions in the last two hours—the latest within the hour—and eleven in the day, with Fort Guile the focus. Fishermans Row, yesterday's storm center, has gone quiet in the last two hours after a busy morning; its six-hour count still stands at seven actions, and the day's total at twenty-eight. Linn Mercy has not recorded a fresh flip since 02:35, though its casualty ledgers remain heavy. Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle have posted no new actions, though their 24-hour histories remain substantial. Elsewhere, Weathered Expanse grinds on with fierce losses but no change of flag, and Clahstra shows accelerating casualty rates on both sides on the war's sixty-eighth day.

history.headline: Fishermans Row Roils; DeadLands Posts Fresh Action
history.war_summary: The latest returns find Fishermans Row still the liveliest front: seven recorded strategic-base actions in the past two hours, bringing the day's count to twenty-eight. DeadLands, quiet at last report, has stirred again with two actions since 07:00 and nine in the day, while casualties on both sides remain mountainous. Linn Mercy has not posted a fresh flip since 02:35, though the casualty ledgers are still heavy and the front remains a mixed Warden-Colonial patchwork. Lykos Isle, Stlican Shelf, and Stonecradle have gone quiet in the two-hour columns but each carries substantial twenty-four-hour histories of captures and losses; Lykos and Stlican remain divided possessions. Weathered Expanse continues to grind without a change of flag, and the general casualty totals across the map suggest no lull in the war's sixty-fifth day.

history.headline: Fishermans Row Erupts; Linn Mercy, DeadLands Go Quiet
history.war_summary: Latest despatches shift the focus to Fishermans Row, where two strategic-base actions have come in the past two hours and twenty-one in the day, with Dankana Post and Fort Ember the busiest points and casualties climbing on both sides. Linn Mercy, the previous night's storm centre, has not reported a fresh flip since 02:35, but remains a costly front with four actions in six hours and heavy recent losses. DeadLands likewise holds the bulletin: two actions in six hours, no new two-hour flip, and daily casualties above ten thousand on each side. Lykos Isle has cooled again after two six-hour actions and no recent event. Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle, active earlier in the day, are silent on strategic bases, while Weathered Expanse continues to bleed heavily without a change in ownership. Clahstra remains punishing but static.

history.headline: Linn Mercy Erupts, DeadLands Keeps Firing as Lykos Fades
history.war_summary: Fresh despatches place Linn Mercy and DeadLands at the centre of the night's fighting. Linn Mercy, silent at the last edition, has logged four strategic-base actions in the past two hours and twenty-nine in the day, with recent fighting around Fort Duncan, Lathair, Outwich Ranch and the Prairie Bazaar; casualty and enlistment rates there are climbing sharply. DeadLands remains a live front, adding two actions in two hours and four in six, with both sides suffering more than twenty thousand casualties in a day. Lykos Isle, which flared overnight, has cooled—no action in the latest two hours after four in six. Fishermans Row and Stlican Shelf have gone quiet on flips despite heavy casualty counts. Weathered Expanse still exacts a fearful toll, with roughly twenty-four thousand Colonial and twenty-three thousand Warden casualties in a day, yet no strategic base has changed hands. Stonecradle, Tempest Island, and KingsCage, active earlier, have settled. Clahstra remains costly but static.

history.headline: Lykos Isle, DeadLands Flare as Fishermans Row Cools
history.war_summary: New despatches show Lykos Isle and DeadLands as the freshest fronts. Lykos Isle logged two strategic-base actions in the past two hours and four in six, latest at 22:25; DeadLands, quiet at the last edition, stirred again with two flips in six hours and seven in a day. Fishermans Row, the previous edition's crucible, has gone silent in the latest two hours after a twenty-action day; Linn Mercy and Stlican Shelf likewise show no flips since evening, though day totals remain high at thirty-two and six. Godcrofts saw three actions in six hours, its latest at 20:15. Weathered Expanse again exacts a fearful toll - more than twenty-two thousand Colonial and nineteen thousand Warden casualties in a day - with no strategic base changing hands. Stonecradle, Tempest Island, KingsCage, Endless Shore, and Oarbreaker remain still after earlier action. Clahstra's casualty rate climbs sharply, but no base flips have been reported there.

history.headline: Fishermans Row Remains Hottest Front as Linn Mercy, Stlican Shelf Act
history.war_summary: The 53rd day of the war finds Fishermans Row still the principal crucible, with eight strategic-base actions in the latest two hours and twenty-six in a day; its last event comes at the cutoff. Linn Mercy, quiet in the previous edition, is stirring once more, logging three actions in two hours and thirty-two in a day, latest at 19:45. Stlican Shelf remains on the boil, with two actions in the latest two hours and six in a day, its last at 20:30. The flare-ups on Tempest Island and KingsCage have burned down—neither shows an action in the past two hours—and Stonecradle has gone silent in the last six hours. DeadLands, Endless Shore, Marban Hollow, Farranac Coast, Oarbreaker, and Stema Landing likewise show no recent flips after earlier action. Weathered Expanse continues to consume lives at a fearful rate—over 19,000 Colonial and 17,000 Warden casualties in a day—yet no strategic base has changed hands there.

history.headline: Tempest Island and KingsCage Join Fishermans Row Fray
history.war_summary: Since the previous edition, Fishermans Row has remained the busiest sector, logging seven strategic-base actions in the last two hours and eighteen in a day, with fighting still hot at the cutoff. Linn Mercy, while quieter than before, still recorded two actions in two hours and eight in six, its day count holding at twenty-nine. New flare-ups have appeared on Tempest Island and in KingsCage, each with three actions in two hours and latest events at the cutoff or shortly before. Stlican Shelf also remains active, with two actions in the latest two hours and a further event at the cutoff. Stonecradle has gone quiet in the immediate hours but still shows five actions in six hours and twelve in a day. DeadLands, Endless Shore, Marban Hollow, Farranac Coast, Oarbreaker, and Stema Landing have all fallen still in the latest six hours. Weathered Expanse continues to bleed heavily—over fifteen thousand Colonial and fourteen thousand Warden casualties in a day—yet reports no base actions.

history.headline: Fishermans Row Rekindles as Linn Mercy Slows
history.war_summary: Since the previous edition, Fishermans Row has jumped to the fore with four strategic-base actions in the latest two hours and fifteen in a day, its most recent event logged at the cutoff. Linn Mercy, last edition's pacesetter, has cooled sharply: two actions in the latest two hours and six in six hours, though its day tally stands at twenty-nine. Stlican Shelf shows fresh pressure, with two new actions in two hours and six in a day. Stonecradle also remains on the board—five actions in six hours, twelve in a day. DeadLands and Endless Shore have gone quiet in the latest six hours, but their day counts remain high at ten and twenty-one, with heavy casualty flows continuing. Marban Hollow, another previously active front, shows no two- or six-hour flips. Farranac Coast, Oarbreaker, and Stema Landing have also fallen still. Weathered Expanse still bleeds heavily—more than sixteen thousand Colonial and fourteen thousand Warden casualties in a day—without recorded base actions. No victory is declared.

history.headline: Linn Mercy Leads Base Surge; DeadLands, Marban Hollow Active
history.war_summary: Since the previous edition, Linn Mercy has seized the pacesetter's role, recording seventeen strategic-base actions in two hours and twenty-three in a day. Marban Hollow, the last report's lone active front, remains hot with four fresh actions. DeadLands, quiet on the flips board when last filed, has resumed with two new base events while casualties mount past seven thousand Colonials and nearly nine thousand Wardens in two hours. Endless Shore and Farranac Coast both show fresh actions; Oarbreaker has seen five in two hours. Stema Landing, silent in the previous dispatch, has joined the roll. Fishermans Row and Drowned Vale, once busy, have cooled. Weathered Expanse still bleeds heavily—some fourteen thousand casualties on each side in a day—yet records no base actions. The front is wide and shifting, and no final decision is yet reported.

history.headline: Marban Hollow Records Only Fresh Base Change; Other Fronts Hold
history.war_summary: Since the previous edition, Marban Hollow has been the sole sector to record fresh strategic-base events, logging two in the past six hours with its latest at 10:01; the front remains divided, three Warden posts to five Colonial, and casualties on both sides are climbing. DeadLands, the last edition's pacesetter, has gone quiet at the flips counter yet still bleeds heavily, with both armies suffering more than 2,900 casualties in six hours. Drowned Vale and Stema Landing stay silent, while Endless Shore retains the war's largest 24-hour event ledger at forty-two, though none since 03:32. Farranac Coast and Weathered Expanse report no fresh base changes but heavy, quickening fire, the latter taking nearly two thousand casualties in two hours. Stlican Shelf and Clahstra show past-day churn but have paused in the latest window.

history.headline: DeadLands Sets New Pace as Drowned Vale, Stema Landing Go Quiet
history.war_summary: Since the previous edition, DeadLands has taken over the lead in strategic-base activity, recording three events in the latest two-hour window and a latest event at 08:41. Its casualty totals remain the heaviest in the war, with both sides recording more than a thousand casualties over six hours. Drowned Vale, the earlier pacesetter, has gone quiet in the latest two-hour window despite eleven events over six hours, and Stema Landing likewise paused after five events in six hours. Endless Shore still holds the day's largest event count at forty-two but has not recorded a change since 03:32. Farranac Coast shows no fresh base flips yet is burning through casualties with warden losses accelerating, and Weathered Expanse likewise remains event-free despite heavy hourly casualties. Stlican Shelf and Marban Hollow both show accelerating casualty rates, the latter with thirteen events in the past day. Elsewhere, many rear sectors remain fixed under one-faction ownership, with no events in the past day.

history.headline: Drowned Vale and Stema Landing Set Pace in Base Reports
history.war_summary: Since the previous edition, the line has moved most sharply around Drowned Vale and Stema Landing. Drowned Vale logged seven ownership events in the latest two-hour window, with Eastmarch and The Wash prominent in the day's tally, while Stema Landing added five events, including repeated work at The Wane. Dead Lands, which had earlier posted a four-event burst, cooled to two events in the final two hours but still shows the war's heaviest casualty rates and a fresh event near dawn. Endless Shore continues to lead the day with forty-two ownership events, yet it has gone quiet in the closing two hours, its last event at 03:32. Palantine Berm and Stlican Shelf also settled after active spells, and Farranac Coast has slowed despite high totals. Tempest Island, Marban Hollow, and Loch Mor retain substantial daily event counts but little fresh movement. Most rear sectors remain fixed under one-faction ownership, with no recorded events in the past day.

history.headline: Six Fronts Trade Bases as War 140 Enters Eleventh Day
history.war_summary: Since the previous edition, the heaviest exchanges have clustered in a half-dozen contested sectors. DeadLands has rekindled with four strategic-base flips in the past two hours, its casualty and enlistment rates accelerating sharply. Endless Shore added three more flips in that same window and remains the war's busiest ground with thirty-seven ownership changes in a day. PalantineBerm matched DeadLands with four flips in two hours, and Stlican Shelf recorded two more, amid climbing casualties on both sides. Stema Landing and the Fingers each show two flips in the latest two-hour span; the Fingers' final event arrived with this edition. Drowned Vale and Farranac Coast, both heavily worked earlier, have gone quiet in the final two hours but still carry large daily flip totals and casualty rolls. history.headline: War 140's Eighth Day: Southern Fronts Trade Bases

Further inland, pure attrition has surged to ferocious levels across both Loch Mor and the Dead Lands, each logging massive, accelerating casualties without immediate changes in base possession.

latest_all_time.headline: Furious Fighting Grips Weathered Expanse As Central Fronts Escalate Attrition
latest_all_time.war_summary: Since the prior edition, Weathered Expanse has reasserted itself as the war's primary flashpoint, logging five base events in the last two hours alone amid fierce fighting around Necropolis and Spirit Watch, leaving one installation in ruins. Simultaneously, Stlican Shelf continues to witness contested ground with fresh engagements registered at The Old Mourn and Vulpine Watch. While the earlier turnover in Callahan's Passage has cooled noticeably over the past two hours, Stonecradle maintains intense pressure following multiple recent clashes over The Long Fast. Maritime skirmishing has flared anew in Godcrofts with a fresh event recorded within the two-hour window, whereas sectors like Fisherman's Row and Oarbreaker have largely settled down. Further inland, pure attrition has surged to ferocious levels across both Loch Mor and the Dead Lands, each logging massive, accelerating casualties without immediate changes in base possession.

history.headline: Storm Shifts to Weathered Expanse as Callahans Passage Falls Silent
history.war_summary: The three hours since our last edition have rearranged the map of the storm. Callahans Passage, so long the seesaw, has gone quiet — no base action in two hours, the guns cooling from their late peak, the Wardens still masters of all ten works. The thunder has rolled instead to Weathered Expanse, where forty-one base actions stand logged in a day, Necropolis and Spirit Watch each fought over eighteen times, the firing unabated as this edition went to press; six of nine posts there fly Warden colours, one lies wrecked. Stlican Shelf burns on about The Old Mourn and Vulpine Watch, the Wardens ahead five works to four. Stonecradle's Long Fast was contested again near press time, though the map moves little. In the Dead Lands no post has fallen these six hours, yet casualty returns swell at a fearful rate; Loch Mor likewise logs the war's heaviest hourly losses without one change of flag. Fishermans Row, after a day of seesaw at Arcadia and Eidolo, rests uneasy and still. By our count the Colonials hold 256 works to the Wardens' 176; the ruins once reported at Godcrofts and Stlican Shelf stand re-manned. It is the war's one-hundred-forty-third day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.

history.headline: Callahans Passage and Stonecradle Swing Back to Warden Hands
history.war_summary: Since our last edition the tide has turned: Callahans Passage, credited to the Colonials at the prior filing, now flies Warden colors once more, all ten strongholds recovered after hours of seesaw fighting in which The Latch — the very work our last report saw filled — was again the storm-centre. The two-hour bill there stands at five hundred twenty-two Colonial and four hundred forty-one Warden fallen, though the guns cool from their peak. Stonecradle has flipped as well: The Long Fast changed hands once more and the map now shows nine Warden works, its two-hour toll near fifteen hundred. Weathered Expanse keeps its grim ledger — forty base actions in a day, Necropolis fought over twenty times — while Stlican Shelf burns on about The Old Mourn and Vulpine Watch, firing even as this edition went to press. Fishermans Row, aflame in our last report, has gone quiet these three hours past, as have the Dead Lands' posts, though both roll up heavy casualty lists. Loch Mor and Linn Mercy log mounting losses without a single base action. The ledger now reads two hundred forty-six Colonial works to one hundred eighty-eight Warden, two in ruin at Godcrofts and Stlican Shelf — a marked swing toward the Warden column. It is the war's one-hundred-fortieth day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.

history.headline: Callahans Passage Wholly Colonial; Fishermans Row Aflame Anew
history.war_summary: Since our last edition, the blank left at The Latch has been filled: Callahans Passage now flies entirely Colonial colors, and its butcher's bill redoubles — near five hundred Colonial and three hundred seventy Warden fallen in the latest hour, the war's steepest. Fishermans Row has rekindled after its lull, forty-nine base actions in a day with Peripti Landing and Arcadia the busiest posts and ownership seesawing nineteen times. Stonecradle burns on, better than nine hundred casualties in two hours since The Long Fast passed to Colonial hands, while Weathered Expanse grinds steadily — thirty-five actions, Necropolis fought over twenty times. Stlican Shelf stays hot about The Old Mourn, Warden losses there climbing, and the Dead Lands cool a shade yet Callahan's Boot remains contested. Tempest Island, Oarbreaker and Lykos Isle show no fresh fighting since our filing. The ledger now reads some two hundred sixty-five Colonial works against one hundred sixty-eight Warden, with but one base in ruin, at Godcrofts, the earlier blanks filled. It is the war's one-hundred-thirty-seventh day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.

history.headline: Callahans Passage Erupts; The Latch Falls Silent
history.war_summary: The guns have opened along Callahans Passage, absent from our earlier editions: losses that ran at single figures now stand near three hundred eighty Colonial and two hundred seventy Warden in the past hour, and The Latch has gone to no-man's-land, the map's newest ruin. The Dead Lands keep their furnace, better than six hundred casualties a side in two hours with Callahan's Boot again the busiest work, while Stonecradle, flared since our last edition, has now given up ground — The Long Fast passed to Colonial hands in the small hours. Weathered Expanse remains the day's most scoured field, twenty-nine base actions with Necropolis fought over seventeen times; Fishermans Row follows at thirty-nine, though its guns ease. Tempest Island has woken again about Isle of Psyche and Surge Gate, Marban Hollow saw Mox taken by Colonials, and Godcrofts and Stlican Shelf stay restless, while Oarbreaker and Lykos Isle lie quiet. The ledger reads two hundred fifty-nine Colonial works against one hundred seventy-two Warden, with three in ruin at Callahans Passage, the Dead Lands and Godcrofts. It is the war's one-hundred-thirty-fourth day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.

history.headline: Dead Lands Roar Anew as Stonecradle Flares
history.war_summary: The Dead Lands lead this edition: a front reported cooling at our last press has rekindled, hourly losses now running some three hundred sixty Colonial and five hundred Warden and still climbing, with Callahan's Boot again the busiest point. Stonecradle, until now a quiet Warden province, has flared within the past two hours, losses leaping from a trickle past four hundred an hour, though not one work has changed hands there. Weathered Expanse remains the bloodiest field of the day — twenty-six base actions in twenty-four hours, Necropolis the most contested of them — though its own toll eases. Fishermans Row grinds on with thirty-six actions in the day, Peripti Landing and Arcadia the busiest works; Godcrofts and Stlican Shelf stay restless; Kings Cage yielded a Colonial capture at the Den of Knaves. Linn Mercy, near eight hundred the hour in our last, has cooled by more than half. Oarbreaker has gone still inside two hours, and Lykos Isle and Tempest Island have gone quiet. The ledger reads two hundred fifty-eight Colonial works to one hundred seventy-five Warden, with three in ruin about Godcrofts and Tempest Island. It is the war's one-hundred-thirty-first day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.

history.headline: Weathered Expanse Now the Bloodiest Field; Fishermans Row Rekindles
history.war_summary: Weathered Expanse has leapt to the fore since our last edition: some twenty-two thousand Warden and eighteen thousand Colonial casualties in the past day, nine base actions within two hours of press, and fighting still under way as this sheet goes to bed, with Necropolis, Spirit Watch, and Wightwalk the busiest points. Fishermans Row, reported still but three hours ago, has rekindled — two actions inside two hours, thirty-three in the day, losses climbing evenly on both sides, Arcadia and Peripti Landing the busiest works. The Dead Lands cool, their hourly toll ebbing, though Callahan's Boot passed to Warden hands; the ground there stands six Colonial to five. Lykos Isle is now wholly Colonial, seven works of seven, after twenty-one actions in the day. Godcrofts, solidly Warden ground, stirs likewise — five actions in two hours at Exile and Lipsia, the last at press time. Oarbreaker and Stlican Shelf fight on; Tempest Island, lately aflame, has gone quiet some four hours; Linn Mercy burns near eight hundred the hour without a work changing hands. The ledger: two hundred fifty Colonial works to one hundred eighty-five Warden, three in ruin. It is the war's one-hundred-twenty-eighth day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.

history.headline: Fishermans Row Falls Still; Oarbreaker and Tempest Flare
history.war_summary: Since our last edition the fires have shifted. Fishermans Row, the day's busiest field at thirty-four actions, has fallen still, quiet some four hours, its nine points standing eight Warden to one Colonial. New flames rise elsewhere: on Oarbreaker, Warden captures are logged at Fort Fogwood and Posterus within two hours of press, casualties climbing hourly; Tempest Island's Surge Gate and Isle of Psyche saw action in the same span, one work left in ruin; and Stlican Shelf fought on inside the two hours, The Old Mourn and Vulpine Watch its pivots. Lykos Isle, whose ruin we lately reported, shows all seven points in keeping again, six Colonial to one Warden. The Dead Lands remain the great slaughter-yard — past eleven thousand Colonial and sixteen thousand Warden casualties in the day, the ground divided six Colonial to five Warden — though the hourly toll cools. In Linn Mercy no works have changed hands, yet the burn there rises fastest of any front, near a thousand Colonial and seven hundred Warden the hour. The ledger stands two hundred fifty Colonial works to one hundred eighty-five Warden, one in ruin — three to the Colonial good since our last accounting. It is the war's one-hundred-twenty-fifth day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.

history.headline: Fishermans Row Boils Anew; Dead Lands and Lykos Isle Stir
history.war_summary: Since our last edition the base war has quickened. Fishermans Row stands busiest of all fields — thirty-eight actions in the day, ten in the past two hours, the newest logged forty-five minutes before press, with Fort Ember, Arcadia, and Peripti Landing the day's pivots — its works holding at eight Warden to one Colonial. The Dead Lands, after the night's passage of The Salt March into Warden keeping, stirred again within the hour, two fresh actions on the books and the field divided six Colonial to five Warden. Lykos Isle filed the war's newest action, scarce half an hour before this edition, the fourteenth of its day, with one work left in ruin. The Weathered Expanse packed all nine of the day's actions into six hours, its newest past five o'clock, though the casualty flood there cools — above twenty thousand Colonial and nearly twenty-four thousand Warden losses in the day. Farranac Coast has shifted no work since four o'clock, yet bleeds faster, past four hundred an hour apiece. Stlican Shelf, Warden save one work, grapples on at Fort Hoarfrost and The Old Mourn. The ledger reads two hundred forty-seven Colonial works to one hundred eighty-eight Warden, one work to the Colonial good since our last accounting. It is the war's one-hundred-twenty-second day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.

history.headline: Weathered Expanse Works Fall at Last; Fishermans Row Rages On
history.war_summary: The latest edition brings a shift long withheld: two works in the Weathered Expanse, Foxcatcher and Necropolis, have gone over to Colonial hands, the newest entry logged scarce a minute before press, even as that field's dreadful casualty ledger cools from its peak — above twenty-two thousand Colonial and twenty-five thousand Warden losses in the day. Fishermans Row remains the busiest base front, thirty actions in twenty-four hours and seven in the last two, Fort Ember again the pivot, with losses re-accelerating toward five hundred Warden and nearly three hundred Colonial in two hours. In the Dead Lands, The Salt March passed through ruin into Warden hands late last evening, while losses there climb past ten and fourteen thousand and still quicken. Lykos Isle keeps its new briskness — twelve actions in the day, the newest before three o'clock. Farranac Coast has moved no base since the small hours, yet bleeds hard, above six thousand apiece, its rates rising; Stlican Shelf, wholly Warden, takes a heavy Colonial casualty surge. Tempest Island and Godcrofts have been quiet since morning. The ledger reads two hundred forty-six Colonial works to one hundred eighty-eight Warden, a net shift toward the Colonial column. It is the war's hundred-and-nineteenth day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.

history.headline: Weathered Expanse Casualties Soar; Fishermans Row Fights On
history.war_summary: The Weathered Expanse bloodletting has swollen still further: not a base there has changed hands, yet the latest hour brought upward of nine hundred Colonial and nearly fourteen hundred Warden casualties, both figures accelerating, with above twenty-one and twenty-three thousand apiece across the day. Fishermans Row remains the liveliest base front — nineteen actions in twenty-four hours, the latest scarce a minute before press, Fort Ember again the pivot — though its losses have cooled from the morning's peak; four works stand apiece there, one in ruins. Lykos Isle has stirred anew after a long stillness, two actions in the past two hours and twenty in the day, Fort Guile and The Squall the busiest posts. Tempest Island has been quiet since half past eight, Godcrofts since seven, Farranac Coast unmoved since four o'clock yet bleeding afresh, and the Dead Lands file no base report since late evening while losing above ten and thirteen thousand. Kings Cage, Marban Hollow and Loch Mor bleed at quickening rates; Clahstra's toll has slackened markedly. The ledger reads two hundred forty-four Colonial works to one hundred ninety-one Warden, a net work to the Colonial column since our last. It is the war's hundred-and-sixteenth day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.

history.headline: Fishermans Row Erupts Anew; Godcrofts Ruin Leaves the Map
history.war_summary: Since our last edition, the fighting has broken out afresh along Fishermans Row, where four base actions in the past two hours — fifteen in the day, Fort Ember the busiest post — sent losses on both sides leaping from near nothing to better than a hundred the hour, the latest action scarcely half an hour old. Tempest Island traded posts through the morning watch, sixteen movements about Isle of Psyche and Surge Gate, the latest at half past eight. Godcrofts has stirred around Lipsia, and the solitary ruin marked there has left the map, the hex now wholly Warden-kept. Farranac Coast's churn about Mara and Terra has slackened, without movement since four o'clock, and Lykos Isle's posts have been still since half past three, though losses there run past four hundred an hour on either side. The Dead Lands file no base report since late evening yet bleed past ten thousand Colonial and nearly fourteen thousand Warden in the day; the motionless Weathered Expanse still tops the butcher's bill at better than twenty-one and twenty-two thousand respectively, with Clahstra likewise bleeding without moving. The ledger stands at two hundred forty-three Colonial works to one hundred ninety-one Warden, none demolished. It is the war's hundred-and-thirteenth day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.

history.headline: Lykos Isle and Farranac Coast Churn as Oarbreaker Falls Quiet
history.war_summary: Since our last edition went to press, the base war has shifted to Lykos Isle and Farranac Coast. Farranac Coast filed fifteen base actions in the day about Mara, Terra and Scythe, the latest shortly after four this morning, with Warden captures outnumbering Colonial five to one; Lykos Isle recorded twenty-four movements, the two sides trading captures nearly evenly about Fort Guile and The Squall as late as 3:38. Oarbreaker's Fort Fogwood flare and Stlican Shelf's small-hours actions have both subsided, the Shelf now wholly in Warden keeping. Godcrofts and the Dead Lands remain silent at their bases since late evening, though the Dead Lands' day's toll still runs past eleven thousand Colonial and thirteen thousand Warden. The Weathered Expanse, without a single base movement, remains the costliest field by far — Warden losses near sixteen hundred the hour, Colonial near eight hundred — with Clahstra also bleeding heavily. Elsewhere the front is largely still. The ledger reads two hundred forty-four Colonial strategic works to one hundred eighty-nine Warden, one demolished at Godcrofts. It is the war's hundred-and-tenth day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.

history.headline: Oarbreaker Flares as Godcrofts and Dead Lands Fall Quiet
history.war_summary: The map's restlessness has shifted westward since our last edition. Oarbreaker, absent from the previous filing, now leads the dispatches: two base actions within the past two hours at Fort Fogwood, among them a Warden capture, while casualties on both sides have climbed from near silence to more than fifty an hour. Stlican Shelf logged two further actions in the small hours about Fort Hoarfrost and now stands wholly in Warden hands. By contrast, Godcrofts — busiest sheet in the last report, with a dozen actions at Lipsia — and the Dead Lands, where the Salt March churned, have filed no new base movements since late evening, though the Dead Lands' day's losses, some twelve thousand Colonial and fifteen thousand Warden, trail only the Weathered Expanse, where Warden casualties are accelerating past eight hundred an hour. Clahstra, quiet at its bases, has begun bleeding furiously, some nine hundred Colonial and thirteen hundred Warden losses in two hours. Fisherman's Row and Lykos Isle likewise rest. The ledger reads two hundred thirty-six Colonial strategic works to one hundred eighty-eight Warden, with one demolished at Godcrofts. This is the hundred-and-seventh day of a war still without a verdict, thirty-four victory towns the prize.

history.headline: Godcrofts Erupts as Dead Lands Resume the Storm
history.war_summary: Since our last edition the torch has passed to Godcrofts: five base actions inside two hours, twelve alone at Lipsia across the day, make it the busiest sheet on the map, though its casualty rolls stay light. The Dead Lands have resumed their storm after the afternoon lull, three actions in two hours about The Salt March, their day's ledger of some twelve thousand six hundred Colonial and fifteen thousand Warden losses second only to the Weathered Expanse, silent in its works yet bleeding at nine hundred Colonial and seven hundred Warden losses an hour. Farranac Coast keeps pace with three late actions around Mara, Scythe and Terra. Fisherman's Row, lively at the previous filing, has gone quiet since its evening work at Fort Ember, and Lykos Isle files no base movement since mid-afternoon even as its casualty returns accelerate sharply. Stlican Shelf logs fresh Warden losses rising in Fort Hoarfrost's account, while Loch Mor, Marban Hollow and Kings Cage cool from earlier violence. The Colonials hold some two hundred thirty strategic works to the Wardens' one hundred eighty-odd, with one base lying demolished at Godcrofts. This is the hundred-and-fourth day of a war still without a verdict, thirty-four victory towns the prize.

history.headline: Fisherman's Row Rekindles While Farranac Coast Stays Hottest
history.war_summary: Farranac Coast holds its place as the liveliest sheet in the war, three base actions within the last two hours and twelve across the day, Scythe and Terra the most-worked grounds, the freshest entry in the field logged this evening. Fisherman's Row has rekindled since our last edition, four actions inside two hours about Fort Ember and Hangman's Court, its casualty returns climbing at an accelerating rate. Tempest Island, busiest in the previous dispatch, has fallen silent these two hours, though fifteen actions stand in its day's account; Lykos Isle likewise slackens to three in six, Fort Guile and The Squall still its most-contested works. Godcrofts keeps up a desultory exchange at Lipsia, and Stlican Shelf shows fresh movement at Fort Hoarfrost. The Dead Lands have filed no base movement since early afternoon, yet their ledger of some thirteen thousand Colonial and fifteen thousand Warden losses in a day remains second only to the Weathered Expanse, which stands silent in works but grimmest of all. This is the hundred-and-first day of a war still without a verdict, thirty-four victory towns the prize.

history.headline: Farranac Coast Erupts as Tempest Island Holds Busiest Hours
history.war_summary: The flare of the hour burns on Farranac Coast, four base actions inside two hours with Scythe the busiest works on that sheet, its losses now running past three thousand the hour between the armies. Tempest Island keeps pace close behind, thirteen actions across the day and the freshest report in the field, Blackwatch, the Isle of Psyche and Surge Gate all touched. Lykos Isle, hottest in our last dispatch, has slackened to a single action in two hours, though twenty-five stand across the day and Fort Guile and The Squall remain its most-worked grounds. Godcrofts has stirred anew around Lipsia, and Fishermen's Row stays busy at Arcadia and Peripti Landing. The Dead Lands have filed no base movement since early afternoon, yet their casualty ledger is the war's second grimmest; the Weathered Expanse, silent in works, tops it with more than thirty-three thousand losses in a day. This is the ninety-eighth day of a war still without a verdict, thirty-four victory towns the prize.

history.headline: Lykos Isle Turns Hottest Front as Weathered Expanse Toll Mounts
history.war_summary: Three hours on, the map's din has moved. Lykos Isle is now the busiest sheet in the field, seven base actions inside the last two hours and twenty-two across the day, with Fort Guile and The Squall each touched eleven times; its split stands three Warden works to four Colonial. The Weathered Expanse keeps the grimmest ledger, hourly losses now past four thousand between the armies and still climbing, while the Dead Lands follow at nearly half that pace, The Salt March and Callahan's Boot the busiest works there, two more events logged inside the last two hours. Tempest Island stirred anew, four actions inside two hours, Blackwatch its busiest ground. Godcrofts, busiest in our last edition, has filed nothing since mid-morning, all nine works still Warden; Fishermen's Row likewise near seventeen hours silent. Marban Hollow, cooled in the previous report, has flared afresh, and Kings Cage with it. This is the ninety-fifth day of a war still without a verdict, thirty-four victory towns the prize.

history.headline: Weathered Expanse Bleeds Steepest as Godcrofts Goes Wholly Warden
history.war_summary: The Weathered Expanse now heads the casualty ledger, its hourly losses climbing past thirteen hundred between the armies, the heaviest pace now showing on any front, while Marban Hollow, grimmest in our last edition, has markedly cooled. Base activity has shifted: The Fingers is the freshest sheet, three actions inside two hours at Headsman's Villa, in a region the Colonials hold seven-strong. Godcrofts, busiest over the day with seventeen events, now shows all nine works in Warden hands, Argosa and Lipsia again the hinges. Lykos Isle has tipped the other way, its Warden holdings reduced from four to three against four Colonial after trading at The Squall and Fort Guile. Tempest Island stirred at Blackwatch and Surge Gate mid-morning. The Deadlands and Farranac Coast have filed no base business since early morning, Fishermen's Row nearer fourteen hours silent, though over the full day the Deadlands' toll remains the war's largest. Stlican Shelf bleeds heavily on, eight Warden holdings to one Colonial. This is the ninety-second day of a war still without a verdict, thirty-four victory towns the prize.

history.headline: Marban Hollow's Toll Mounts as Lykos Isle Flares
history.war_summary: Since the last edition, Farranac Coast's flare has died, its last base action coming at half past five, and the Deadlands, so long the heaviest field, have filed nothing since four o'clock. Fishermen's Row, too, has stood silent near eleven hours. In their place Lykos Isle is the freshest sheet: two actions inside the past two hours, the latest within minutes of this writing, Fort Guile and The Squall the busiest posts, the island's seven works standing four Warden to three Colonial. Godcrofts keeps stirring, four events in six, Argosa and Lipsia again the centers of trade, seven Warden bases against one Colonial and one in no-man's-land. The grimmest ledger is Marban Hollow, where the casualty pace has climbed steeply in the past two hours — better than a thousand felled, Colonial losses more than doubled, some three hundred the hour on either side — though its eight bases still hold seven Colonial to one Warden. The Weathered Expanse bleeds at a like rate, steady rather than rising, while Stlican Shelf cools from its peak. This is the eighty-ninth day of a war still without a verdict, thirty-four victory towns the prize.

history.headline: Farranac Coast Flares as Rival Fronts Fall Silent
history.war_summary: Tempest Island, last edition's lead, has gone still, Blackwatch quiet for nearly five hours, and Fishermen's Row, Godcrofts and Stema Landing's Wane have likewise fallen silent, their base events now six to eight hours old. Farranac Coast takes up the story: three events inside the past two hours, the last within the half-hour, with Mara and Scythe the busiest posts and two works taken by the Colonials among the day's six actions, the map now standing nine Colonial to two Warden. The Deadlands filed two events in the six-hour window but none since; The Salt March and Callahan's Boot again drew the heaviest trade, casualties still run above six hundred an hour a side, and the eleven works stand seven Colonial to four Warden. The Weathered Expanse runs a close second in the day's butcher's bill, its rate cooling. On Stlican Shelf, eight of nine works Warden-held, Warden losses have climbed past four hundred an hour. This is the eighty-sixth day of a war still without a verdict, thirty-four victory towns the prize.

history.headline: Tempest Island Flares Anew as Stema Landing Goes Quiet
history.war_summary: Tempest Island leads this edition: Blackwatch, the isle's busiest post, saw action within the past two hours, the freshest event on any front, and the ledger now shows no work left in no-man's-land, the neutral ground returned to Colonial keeping. Stema Landing, our previous lead, has fallen silent, its last event more than three hours old, though The Wane logged six actions on the day and all nine works remain Colonial-held. Fishermen's Row still tops the day's ledger with twenty-three events, three inside six hours, its works standing eight Warden to one Colonial, Peripti Landing and Dankana Post drawing the busiest trade. Godcrofts counted nine actions over the day, Argosa the busiest, with all nine posts Warden-held. The Deadlands, eight hours without a base event, grind on regardless: casualties run near seven hundred an hour a side, The Salt March and Callahan's Boot the contested posts, eight of eleven works Colonial-held. Farranac Coast filed three actions at Mara, while Linn of Mercy and the Weathered Expanse stay quiet on bases though their casualty tallies remain steep. This is the eighty-third day of a war still awaiting its verdict, thirty-four victory towns the prize.

history.headline: Stema Landing Wakes Anew as Deadlands Toll Mounts
history.war_summary: Stema Landing opens this dispatch: four base events in the past two hours, the newest logged some twenty minutes before filing, with The Wane the busiest post and all nine of its works still in Colonial hands. Fishermen's Row, our last edition's lead, remains the day's busiest ground, twenty-three events on the day's ledger and three more in the latest span; its nine works now stand eight Warden to one Colonial, a further turn from the seven-two split last reported, with Peripti Landing and Dankana Post again drawing the fire. Godcrofts has cooled to a single recent event, and its lone no-man's-land post has been restored, putting all nine works in Warden hands. The Deadlands have filed no base events for more than five hours, yet combined losses near four thousand in the past two hours and still climb; The Salt March and Callahan's Boot remain the contested posts, and eight of eleven works are Colonial-held. Tempest Island keeps one work in no-man's-land, while Linn of Mercy and Farranac Coast, quiet on bases, show steeply rising losses. The Weathered Expanse, likewise silent, counts better than fourteen thousand casualties a side over the day. This is the eightieth day of a war still awaiting its verdict, thirty-four victory towns the prize.

history.headline: Fishermen's Row Rekindles as Godcrofts Front Falls Quiet
history.war_summary: Fishermen's Row, silent at our last edition, leads tonight's dispatch with five base events in the past two hours, the newest little more than half an hour before filing; Peripti Landing and Dankana Post bear the brunt, and its nine works now stand seven Warden to two Colonial, a marked swing from the five-and-four split last reported. The Deadlands returned to action some two hours before this edition, The Salt March and Callahan's Boot again the busiest posts, with eight of eleven works now Colonial-held. Godcrofts, the previous edition's lead, has cooled to a single event in the same span; eight works are Warden-held and one lies in no-man's-land. Farranac Coast has logged no fresh base events for better than three hours, yet its casualty pace still climbs. Linn of Mercy and Lykos Isle, both still divided, have filed no new base events for many hours, though Lykos casualties climb anew. Kings Cage and Marban Hollow, lately rising, now show cooling losses. The Weathered Expanse exacts the day's heaviest toll, more than fourteen thousand casualties on either side within twenty-four hours and still accelerating. This is the seventy-seventh day of the war; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and no victor is declared.

history.headline: Godcrofts Flares Anew as Fishermen's Row Falls Silent
history.war_summary: Since our last edition the map of activity has shifted. Godcrofts, which had been keeping still, now leads the dispatch: five base events in the past two hours, the latest shortly before our filing, centred on Argosa and Lipsia, and two of its works now lie demolished between the lines. Farranac Coast stirred within the past quarter-hour, fresh fighting recorded at Mara while its casualty pace climbs. Fishermen's Row, which roared through the day with twenty-five recorded events, has gone quiet; its newest entry is nearly three hours old and its nine works still divide five Warden to four Colonial. The Deadlands likewise rest since mid-afternoon, but not before the balance moved further to the Colonials, seven of eleven works now, with The Salt March the most contested post. Linn of Mercy and Lykos Isle, both still divided, have reported nothing since morning. Elsewhere the flags are unmoved though the toll mounts: Kings Cage and Marban Hollow show sharply rising hourly losses, and the Weathered Expanse passes thirty-two thousand casualties for the day without a change of colours. This is the seventy-fourth day of the war; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and no victor is declared.

history.headline: Fishermen's Row Erupts Anew as Deadlands Toll Mounts
history.war_summary: Since our last edition, Fishermen's Row has roared back to life after its brief lull: six base events in the past two hours, the latest at our filing, and its nine works narrowed to five Warden against four Colonial. The Deadlands logged no flips in the same span, its newest event a little over two hours old, yet the day's toll there passes 32,000 and its eleven works now read six Colonial to five Warden, the hourly pace easing from noon's fury. rounds.war_summary: The three hours since our last edition have rearranged the map of the storm. Callahans Passage, so long the seesaw, has gone quiet — no base action in two hours, the guns cooling from their late peak, the Wardens still masters of all ten works. The thunder has rolled instead to Weathered Expanse, where forty-one base actions stand logged in a day, Necropolis and Spirit Watch each fought over eighteen times, the firing unabated as this edition went to press; six of nine posts there fly Warden colours, one lies wrecked. Stlican Shelf burns on about The Old Mourn and Vulpine Watch, the Wardens ahead five works to four. Stonecradle's Long Fast was contested again near press time, though the map moves little. In the Dead Lands no post has fallen these six hours, yet casualty returns swell at a fearful rate; Loch Mor likewise logs the war's heaviest hourly losses without one change of flag. Fishermans Row, after a day of seesaw at Arcadia and Eidolo, rests uneasy and still. By our count the Colonials hold 256 works to the Wardens' 176; the ruins once reported at Godcrofts and Stlican Shelf stand re-manned. It is the war's one-hundred-forty-third day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.

DeadLands, quiet on the flips board when last filed, has resumed with two new base events while casualties mount past seven thousand Colonials and nearly nine thousand Wardens in two hours. Endless Shore and Farranac Coast both show fresh actions; Oarbreaker has seen five in two hours. Stema Landing, silent in the previous dispatch, has joined the roll. Fishermans Row and Drowned Vale, once busy, have cooled. Weathered Expanse still bleeds heavily—some fourteen thousand casualties on each side in a day—yet records no base actions. The front is wide and shifting, and no final decision is yet reported.

rounds.war_summary: With no decision yet rendered on the thirty-seventh day of the war, the map stands divided between settled districts and a burning central belt. Most provinces rest firmly under one banner, but the Deadlands remain split six bases to five, while neighboring Linn Mercy flashed through twenty-three ownership changes in a single day, its posts passing back and forth almost by the hour. Endless Shore counted sixteen similar convulsions, with Brackish Point the busiest crossing, and Farranac Coast, Marban Hollow, and Oarbreaker — where one work now lies in ruin — each logged fighting inside the last two hours. In the Fishermen's Row and Godcrofts sectors the Wardens hold near-complete ground, though Colonial flags were raised over individual points within the day. The casualty ledger is heaviest in the Deadlands, where the combined toll since the war began approaches fifty thousand. Fresh names appeared on every regional roll through the day, an unbroken tide of enlistment amid the churn.

rounds.war_summary: Over the past three hours, direct base transitions have ground to a complete halt across the entire front, yet bloodletting has escalated sharply into pure attritional combat. Weathered Expanse has surged to become the war's deadliest sector, absorbing nearly two thousand combined casualties in the last two hours as enlistment rates accelerate dramatically. In Dead Lands, where intense base trading marked earlier dispatches, frontline movement has stalled following morning skirmishes near Sun's Hollow and Liberation Point, though heavy gunfire still claimed nearly two thousand lives in the latest reporting window. Marban Hollow emerged as a fresh contested zone during the morning hours, recording multiple base shifts around The Spitrocks and Checkpoint Bua before combat settled into an active stalemate. Attrition also remains elevated along the coastal and central corridors of Loch Mor, Farranac Coast, Endless Shore, and The Fingers, where casualty rates continue to climb despite unchanged territorial lines. Meanwhile, rear territories and consolidated zones like Drowned Vale remain thoroughly subdued.

In Dead Lands the Warden advantage holds at seven bases to four Colonial, with a fresh surge of captures at Liberation Point and Sun's Hollow early this morning and casualty rates for both sides accelerating sharply — Warden losses now exceeding 1,180 per hour. Endless Shore remains largely Colonial (nine to one) but the front has heated: 42 base changes in the past day, Colonial casualties climbing to 154 per hour while Warden losses reach 254 per hour, and enlistments rising on both sides. Farranac Coast shows a similar flare, 18 ownership flips yesterday and casualty rates spiking to 197 Colonial and 228 Warden per hour, with enlistments climbing on both factions. Marban Hollow entered the fight today, recording 15 captures since 10:01 and casualty rates accelerating above 130 per hour for each side. The Fingers remain evenly split (four Colonial, three Warden) after two Colonial captures overnight, and casualty rates there have jumped above 100 per hour for both armies. Drowned Vale stays a Colonial stronghold (12‑0) but activity has quieted, with no captures in the last six hours and casualty rates flat. Enlistments are rising in Dead Lands, Farranac Coast and Marban Hollow, signalling fresh reinforcements at the hottest sectors, while they cool on Drowned Vale and Endless Shore.

rounds.war_summary: The twentieth day of the war shows no slackening at the front. In the Dead Lands the ledger has climbed to eleven thousand eight hundred sixty-nine Colonial and thirteen thousand five hundred ninety-eight Warden names since our last edition, with base activity logged as recently as mid-morning; seventeen events stand recorded across the day, chiefly at Liberation Point and Sun's Hollow, and the strongpoint count there holds at seven Wardens against four Colonials. Marban Hollow is the freshest field of action, its last entry filed only hours ago amid a five-to-three Colonial edge and a casualty toll climbing fast on both sides. Weathered Expanse reports enormous losses — seven thousand seven hundred forty-nine against seven thousand five hundred seven — with rates accelerating sharply, though not a single base movement appears in its record. Callahan's Passage likewise burns hot, warden losses outpacing colonial ones as enlistments surge. Endless Shore, yesterday's busiest field with forty-two events around Woodbind and Saltbrook Channel, has gone quiet since the small hours; Drowned Vale and Farranac Coast have also stilled. Rear provinces from Godcrofts to Westgate sit undisturbed behind undisputed colors, and thirty-four victory towns remain required before any victor may be declared.

data_dictionary.none_state: NONE means the strategic base is destroyed or demolished and has not been rebuilt by either faction; it is effectively no-man's-land.
data_dictionary.rate_trends: Adjacent equal-window comparison. Array order is [recent_per_hour, previous_per_hour, change_per_hour, direction].
data_dictionary.recent_events: A direct ownership flip can produce a loss row plus a capture row for the same state transition.
data_dictionary.selected_metrics: Evidence citation keys whose values and observation times are frozen at prediction time.
data_dictionary.total_enlistments: Cumulative unique players who have deployed to this region during the war. A player can count in multiple regions. This is not current population or a faction split; its change is only a new-to-that-region activity proxy.
